queries.runs_page: SELECT run_id, name, config, datasets, status, created_at, completed_at, summary, error, project_id, CAST(ROUND((julianday(completed_at) - julianday(created_at)) * 86400.0, 3) AS INTEGER) AS duration_seconds FROM runs WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR project_id = ?1) ORDER BY created_at DESC, run_id ASC LIMIT ?2 OFFSET ?3
queries.runs_total: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR project_id = ?1)
queries.run_counts: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.refit_context IS NOT NULL THEN pr.chain_id END) AS final_models_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.refit_context IS NULL AND pr.fold_id NOT IN ('avg', 'w_avg') AND pr.fold_id NOT LIKE '%_agg' THEN pr.fold_id END) AS total_folds, COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.partition = 'val' AND pr.refit_context IS NULL AND pr.fold_id NOT IN ('avg', 'w_avg') AND pr.fold_id NOT LIKE '%_agg' THEN 1 END) AS total_models_trained, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pipelines WHERE run_id = ?1) AS pipeline_runs_count FROM predictions AS pr JOIN pipelines AS pl ON pl.pipeline_id = pr.pipeline_id WHERE pl.run_id = ?1
queries.run_model_classes: SELECT c.model_class AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM chains AS c JOIN pipelines AS pl ON pl.pipeline_id = c.pipeline_id WHERE pl.run_id = ?1 GROUP BY c.model_class ORDER BY count DESC, c.model_class ASC
queries.run_artifact_size: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.size_bytes), 0) FROM artifacts AS a WHERE a.artifact_id IN (SELECT j.value FROM chains AS c JOIN pipelines AS pl ON pl.pipeline_id = c.pipeline_id, json_tree(c.fold_artifacts) AS j WHERE pl.run_id = ?1 AND j.type = 'text' UNION SELECT j.value FROM chains AS c JOIN pipelines AS pl ON pl.pipeline_id = c.pipeline_id, json_tree(c.shared_artifacts) AS j WHERE pl.run_id = ?1 AND j.type = 'text')

semantics.metadata: same fields and null normalization as studio_run_detail_v1; names and project identities remain exact
semantics.duration_seconds: whole elapsed seconds from stored timestamps, millisecond precision; null for absent or unparseable timestamps
semantics.counts: stored prediction metadata only; no inferred folds or invented final models
semantics.artifact_size_bytes: sum each distinct registered artifact once, including nested fold/shared references; no filesystem traversal
semantics.scores: consume workspace-store-results-summary.v1 sources; never compute scientific metrics from prediction arrays
